title: Placement and the top-edge rule
units: CSS px, physical, relative to the container border box; box is getBoundingClientRect (the border box); lines are unions of Ahem glyph rects per block container

p-inline-start.note: float:inline-start resolves against the containing block direction

p-inline-start-own-rtl.note: float:inline-start with direction:rtl on the float itself: the containing block decides

p-inline-start-own-ltr.note: float:inline-start with direction:ltr on the float itself

p-left-row.note: three left floats 50x20 side by side

p-right-row.note: three right floats 50x20 side by side

p-left-wrap.note: three left floats 80x20: the third does not fit and goes below

p-left-wrap-step.note: left 80x40, left 80x20, left 80x20: the third lands at the second float bottom beside the first

p-right-then-left.note: right 100x30 then left 120x10: the left goes below the right

p-top-edge.note: left 150x40, right 30x10, left 100x10 (goes to 40), right 30x10 must not rise above 40

p-top-edge-gap.note: left 190x10, left 50x50 (goes to 10), right 5x5 fits at 0 but the top-edge rule holds it at 10

p-margins.note: left float 50x30 with 5px margins on every side, then a left float 20x20

p-margins-logical.note: margin-inline-start 7, margin-block-start 3 on a left float, then a right float with margin-inline-end 9

p-neg-margin-end.note: left float with margin-inline-end -20px, then a left float that overlaps it

p-neg-margin-overlap-all.note: left float whose margin box has zero inline size (margin-inline-end -50px)

p-neg-margin-block.note: left float with margin-block-start -8px after a 20px block

p-wider-than-cb.note: left float 250 wide in 200: placed at the start and overflows

p-wider-after-float.note: left 50x20, then left 250x10: goes below the first where the full width is free

p-auto-width.note: left float with auto width and text "aa bb": shrink-to-fit

p-auto-width-wrap.note: left float with auto width and long text: clamps to the available size

p-auto-width-beside.note: auto-width float after a 60px float: its available size is the full container, not the remainder

p-fractional-overflow.note: four 25.1px left floats in 100: the fourth may wrap

p-fractional-height.note: left 60x10.3, left 60x10.3, left 100x5: the third goes to the lower float bottom

p-in-child-margin.note: float first in a child with margin-block-start 15 (the child margin collapses through the float)

p-after-margin.note: float between a block with margin-block-end 20 and a block with margin-block-start 10

p-text-fits.note: float after "aa " on the line fits: placed on the current line

p-text-fits-right.note: right float after "aa " on the line

p-text-nofit.note: float 120 after 140px of text in 200: pushed below the line

p-text-nofit-trailing-space.note: float that fits only once the trailing space is excluded

p-text-exact.note: float that exactly fills the rest of the line

p-text-ancestor-end.note: float inside a span with padding-inline-end 50: the padding counts toward the float fit

p-text-second-pending.note: two floats in one line: the first is pushed after the line, so the second is too

p-text-leading.note: float before any text on the line

p-text-second-line.note: float in the second line of a paragraph
p-text-second-line.html:
aaa bbb ccc
ddd eee fff

p-clear-self.note: right float with clear:right after two right floats

p-clear-self-left.note: right float with clear:left after a left float

p-computed-display.note: computed display of floated inline, inline-block, inline-flex, inline-grid, inline-table, list-item, table-cell, contents
p-computed-display.html: abcdefgh

p-computed-none.note: computed float of absolute, fixed, flex item and grid item

p-orthogonal.note: float with the other writing mode: its size in the container axes
